punchline: A month with no screens, then two days a week, two hours a day, and only with friends.
thirty_sec: Anna Lembke describes a patient in his early twenties who played video games most of every day. After a one-month dopamine fast he reported less anxiety and depression, then returned to gaming under rules he set: limited days and hours, no highly addictive games, separate laptops, only with friends.
question: Which habit of yours would feel different if you fixed the day, the length and the place before the next time you do it?
key_contrast: A clean break first, then rules decided in advance.
